critical_code_review_comments: server.py at ~5400 lines is well past the 700-line guideline — the new /api/trucker/* block is clean but the overall file should be modularized in a future pass (separate routers per domain). Non-blocking.
trucker_ai.py is excellent: every endpoint returns explicit source + source_url, all outbound calls have 10s timeouts, no fabrication on failure. Matches the strict-on-outbound policy perfectly.
Diesel-prices intentionally returns source='eia_scaffold' when EIA_API_KEY is empty — this is the documented pragmatic policy and is clearly labeled (not hidden mock). Acceptable.
TruckerAIPanel.jsx State511View fetches inside useEffect — for tests, brief wait needed before assertions (~1.5s). Not a bug, just a noteworthy load timing for future testing agents.
